## Background

Report failures from Megatron-LM's merge-queue testing jobs to the CI Slack channel using the shared notifier from NVIDIA-NeMo/FW-CI-templates#593.

## What changed

Add `notify-merge-group-failure` to `cicd-main.yml`, covering the four H100/GB200 unit and integration testing jobs. Alerts run only for uncancelled `merge_group` runs in `NVIDIA/Megatron-LM` targeting the repository's default branch, when at least one testing job fails. Scheduled and manually dispatched runs do not send these alerts.

## Details

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Merge queue checks requested] --> B[H100 and GB200 unit and integration tests]
  B --> C{Testing job failed and run uncancelled?}
  C -->|Yes, canonical default branch| D[Shared failure summary]
  D --> E[CI Slack channel]
```

Check `github.event.merge_group.base_ref` against `refs/heads/<default_branch>` so synthetic queue head refs are accepted. Keep existing workflow triggers and testing jobs unchanged. Pin `notify-ci-failure` to `631c404d00a9e60afc591cd071d35d2e18f82fc6`, use `environment: main` for `SLACK_WEBHOOK`, and give the notification job no token permissions or failed-run checkout. Add dependency-free wiring tests to the existing CPU lint job. `populate-build-cache.yml` is unchanged.

## Tested

Validated commit `57f8bf2d22` after merging upstream `main` at `adcd90f4b2`:

- `python3 .github/scripts/test_ci_notifications.py`: all four tests passed.
- `node /tmp/mlm-pr8289-merge-group/verify-condition.mjs`: 4,200 cases passed using `@actions/expressions` 0.3.61, including every testing-job failure, cancellation, alternate targets, fork repositories, synthetic queue refs, schedule, dispatch, push, and pull-request events.
- Parsed YAML comparison against upstream `main`: existing triggers and jobs unchanged after removing the notifier and its lint test step; cache workflow unchanged.
- `actionlint -format '{{json .}}' -stdin-filename .github/workflows/cicd-main.yml -`: candidate and upstream have the same 42 diagnostics; no new findings.
- `uvx --from black==26.3.0 black --check .github/scripts/test_ci_notifications.py` and `uvx --from isort==5.13.2 isort --check-only .github/scripts/test_ci_notifications.py`: passed.
- `BASE_REF=main CHECK_ONLY=true SKIP_DOCS=false bash tools/autoformat.sh`: passed; no applicable changes under its `megatron/core` and `tests` scope.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- GitHub API: the `main` environment currently has no deployment branch restrictions or protection rules, so queue refs can use its secret.

Hosted CI and real Slack delivery remain unverified; no test Slack messages were sent.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Validate merge-group testing notifications without model or YAML dependencies."""
+
+import re
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+
+
+class TestMergeGroupNotification(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Keep merge-group test alerts complete, immutable, and out of cache population."""
+
+    def setUp(self) -> None:
+        self.workflow = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/cicd-main.yml").read_text()
+        self.notify = self.workflow.split("  notify-merge-group-failure:\n", 1)[1].split(
+            "\n  Coverage_Fake:", 1
+        )[0]
+
+    def test_reports_every_testing_job_result(self) -> None:
+        jobs = set(re.findall(r"^  ([\w-]+):$", self.workflow.split("\njobs:\n", 1)[1], re.M))
+        dependencies = re.search(r"^    needs: \[([^]]+)\]$", self.notify, re.M)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(dependencies)
+        assert dependencies is not None
+        testing_jobs = {
+            "cicd-unit-tests-latest",
+            "cicd-unit-tests-latest-gb200",
+            "cicd-integration-tests-latest-h100",
+            "cicd-integration-tests-latest-gb200",
+        }
+        self.assertTrue(testing_jobs <= jobs)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            {
+                job
+                for job in jobs
+                if re.fullmatch(r"cicd-(unit|integration)-tests-latest(?:-.*)?", job)
+            },
+            testing_jobs,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(set(dependencies[1].split(", ")), testing_jobs)
+        self.assertIn("runs-on: ubuntu-latest", self.notify)
+        self.assertIn("environment: main", self.notify)
+        self.assertIn("permissions: {}", self.notify)
+        self.assertIn(
+            "uses: NVIDIA-NeMo/FW-CI-templates/.github/actions/notify-ci-failure@"
+            "631c404d00a9e60afc591cd071d35d2e18f82fc6",
+            self.notify,
+        )
+        self.assertIn("needs-json: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}", self.notify)
+        self.assertIn("webhook: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}", self.notify)
+        self.assertNotIn("checkout", self.notify)
+        self.assertNotIn("run:", self.notify)
+
+    def test_only_alerts_on_uncancelled_default_branch_merge_group_failures(self) -> None:
+        condition = self.notify.split("    if: >-\n", 1)[1].split("    steps:", 1)[0]
+        self.assertIn("always() && !cancelled() && contains(needs.*.result, 'failure')", condition)
+        self.assertNotIn("failure()", condition)
+        self.assertIn("github.repository == 'NVIDIA/Megatron-LM'", condition)
+        self.assertIn("github.event_name == 'merge_group'", condition)
+        self.assertIn(
+            "github.event.merge_group.base_ref == "
+            "format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)",
+            condition,
+        )
+        self.assertNotIn("github.ref", condition)
+        self.assertNotIn("schedule", condition)
+        self.assertNotIn("workflow_dispatch", condition)
+        self.assertNotIn("||", condition)
+        self.assertNotIn("outputs", condition)
+        self.assertNotIn("push", condition)
+
+    def test_cache_population_does_not_send_testing_notifications(self) -> None:
+        cache = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/populate-build-cache.yml").read_text()
+        self.assertNotIn("notify-merge-group-failure:", cache)
+        self.assertNotIn("/notify-ci-failure@", cache)
+
+    def test_does_not_restore_daily_gpu_test_schedule(self) -> None:
+        triggers = self.workflow.split("\non:\n", 1)[1].split("\nconcurrency:", 1)[0]
+        self.assertNotIn("schedule:", triggers)
+        self.assertIn("  merge_group:\n    types: [checks_requested]", triggers)
+        self.assertIn("      - name: Test merge-group testing notification wiring", self.workflow)
+        self.assertIn("run: python3 .github/scripts/test_ci_notifications.py", self.workflow)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

@@ -657,6 +657,9 @@ jobs:
       - name: Test DCO gate publisher
         run: python3 .github/scripts/test_dco_gate.py
 
+      - name: Test merge-group testing notification wiring
+        run: python3 .github/scripts/test_ci_notifications.py
+
       - name: Test superseded merge-group cleanup
         run: python3 .github/scripts/test_cancel_superseded_merge_group_runs.py
 
@@ -1512,6 +1515,26 @@ jobs:
             exit 1
           fi
 
+  notify-merge-group-failure:
+    name: Notify merge-group testing failure
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    environment: main
+    needs: [cicd-unit-tests-latest, cicd-unit-tests-latest-gb200, cicd-integration-tests-latest-h100, cicd-integration-tests-latest-gb200]
+    permissions: {}
+    # Report test failures, not failed ancestors or build-cache population.
+    # Queue runs use a synthetic head ref; check the target branch instead.
+    if: >-
+      ${{ always() && !cancelled() && contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') &&
+          github.repository == 'NVIDIA/Megatron-LM' &&
+          github.event_name == 'merge_group' &&
+          github.event.merge_group.base_ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch) }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Notify CI alerts channel
+        uses: NVIDIA-NeMo/FW-CI-templates/.github/actions/notify-ci-failure@631c404d00a9e60afc591cd071d35d2e18f82fc6
+        with:
+          needs-json: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
+          webhook: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}
+
   Coverage_Fake:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     needs: [Nemo_CICD_Test, pre-flight]
